trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take the Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$25-35) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and review your Disney World park tickets and schedule for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done. Get to bed early to prepare for a full first park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Eat before or during your flight
meals.lunch: Eat before or during your flight
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night snack from a vending machine or the hotel lobby convenience area. Alternatively, a nearby 24-hour McDonald's or Denny's on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy is within a short drive (~5 min).

day_by_day.notes: Upon check-in, confirm the free theme park shuttle schedule with the front desk. The Ramada shuttle typically runs on a fixed schedule, so knowing pickup times is critical for planning each day. Purchase a multi-day Disney ticket in advance online to save money — a 7-day ticket offers the best per-day value. Stock up on snacks and water bottles at a nearby Walmart (~10 min drive on US-192) to bring into the parks and save on food costs.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom — aim for the earliest shuttle to arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland and ride Space Mountain before lines build. Then hit Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Haunted Mansion. Use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times and grab Lightning Lane passes for top rides if budget allows ($15-25/person add-on).
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, explore Fantasyland — ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (grab a Lightning Lane early), Peter Pan's Flight, and 'it's a small world.' Visit Liberty Square and watch the Hall of Presidents. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed (use the shuttle) to avoid peak heat and crowds, then return for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening parade (Festival of Fantasy, check current schedule) and the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle — one of the best free included experiences in all of Disney World. Depart via the hotel shuttle after the fireworks.

meals.breakfast: Eat a filling breakfast at the hotel before departure or bring snacks from your Walmart haul. Grab a quick coffee and pastry at the Main Street Bakery (Starbucks) inside Magic Kingdom (~$6-10).
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — one of Magic Kingdom's most affordable quick-service spots. Try the lobster roll or chicken sandwich combo (~$12-15/person).
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — large portions, budget-friendly, with a rotating menu of burgers, chicken, and salads (~$12-16/person). Alternatively, bring a packed dinner from the hotel to eat in the park.

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the park entrance 30 minutes before official opening for the best chance at low wait times on top rides. Bring refillable water bottles — free ice water is available at any quick-service location. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen generously. June in Orlando is hot and humid with afternoon thunderstorms common — carry a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Enter through the main gate and head to World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required, set an alarm for 7:00 AM to grab a virtual queue spot via the app). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for a family-friendly option).
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Nature — ride Soarin' Around the World (grab a Lightning Lane if wait exceeds 45 min) and Living with the Land boat ride. Then stroll through World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM — explore the pavilions of Mexico, Norway (ride Frozen Ever After), China, and Japan. Sample affordable international snacks as you walk through each country.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's Harmonious nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (check current show schedule — it may be replaced by a new show by 2027, but a nighttime lagoon show is a staple). Browse the World Showcase pavilions in the evening when temperatures drop. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks from the hotel or grab a quick bite at Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value quick-service spots with fresh, healthy options (~$10-14/person).
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — rotisserie chicken, Asian noodle bowls, sandwiches, and salads at reasonable prices (~$12-15/person).
meals.dinner: Graze through World Showcase for dinner — budget-friendly options include a School Bread from Norway (~$5), a crepe from France (~$8), tacos from Mexico's La Cantina de San Angel (~$12-14), and a Kakigori shaved ice from Japan (~$5). This 'snack dinner' approach is fun and cost-effective.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park — wear very comfortable shoes. The virtual queue for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind is highly competitive; set a phone alarm for exactly 7:00 AM on the day of your visit and have the app open and ready. The World Showcase is a wonderful free cultural experience even without riding attractions.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. This park requires the most strategic planning. Upon entry, immediately join the virtual queue or purchase Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (the most in-demand ride at Disney World). Head to Toy Story Land first — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers before lines grow. Then head to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge to explore and ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run.
day_by_day.afternoon: After lunch, experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (using your virtual queue or Lightning Lane return time). Then visit Sunset Boulevard — ride Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show (check schedule — typically runs multiple times daily, free with park admission).
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Fantasmic! nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (check current schedule — typically runs in the evening and is included with park admission). Arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seating. This is one of Disney's most beloved nighttime spectaculars. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks from the hotel. Grab a Ronto Wrap from Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge (~$13) — a fan-favorite and surprisingly filling breakfast/brunch option.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of Hollywood Studios' most affordable and beloved quick-service spots. Try the Totchos (tater tot nachos) or grilled cheese sandwich (~$10-13/person).
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary near the park's center — a large, air-conditioned quick-service restaurant with burgers, wraps, and salads at reasonable prices (~$12-15/person). Or bring a packed dinner from the hotel.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is the most attraction-dense park relative to its size, meaning lines can be very long. Strategic use of Lightning Lane and virtual queues is especially important here. The park can feel crowded in June — use the app to monitor wait times and visit popular rides during parades or shows when crowds thin. Fantasmic! seating fills up fast — plan to arrive very early.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom — arrive at rope drop. Head immediately to Pandora: The World of Avatar — ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the most popular ride in the park, with waits often exceeding 2 hours by mid-morning) and Na'vi River Journey. Then explore the rest of Pandora before heading to Africa.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Africa — ride Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning for active animals, but afternoon is still worthwhile). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail for free wildlife viewing. Head to Asia — ride Expedition Everest and Kali River Rapids (you WILL get wet — plan accordingly or skip if you want to stay dry). Visit DinoLand U.S.A. and ride DINOSAUR.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime show or the Tree of Life Awakenings (check 2027 schedule — Animal Kingdom's evening entertainment varies). The Tree of Life projection show is free and runs throughout the evening on the Tree of Life. Enjoy the park's unique atmosphere as it transitions to night. Take the hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Bring snacks from the hotel. Grab a Pongu Pongu drink (Night Blossom) in Pandora as a fun treat (~$6-8).
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue in Discovery Island — one of the best quick-service meals in all of Disney World. Ribs, chicken, and pulled pork with beautiful outdoor waterfront seating (~$14-18/person). Worth every penny.
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Local Food Cafes in Asia — a quick-service window with Asian-inspired dishes like teriyaki beef bowls and fried rice at budget-friendly prices (~$10-14/person). Or pack a dinner from the hotel.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active and temperatures are cooler. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks (around 8-9 PM), so plan your day accordingly. Bring a change of clothes or a poncho if riding Kali River Rapids. The Kilimanjaro Safaris experience is genuinely world-class and completely included with park admission.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a relaxed morning at the hotel. Use the hotel pool to cool off and recharge after four consecutive park days. This is a great day to do laundry, repack, and rest your feet. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the hotel.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare (~$10-15) to Disney Springs — Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district on the shores of Lake Buena Vista. Explore the shops, browse the World of Disney store (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), visit the LEGO store, and enjoy the lively atmosphere. Check out the free entertainment and street performers. Visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling alley just to look around, or play a round of mini golf at Fantasia Gardens (~$14/person) nearby.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy dinner at Disney Springs before heading back to the hotel. Browse the many restaurant options. Spend the evening packing, reviewing your final park day plan, and relaxing. Consider visiting a nearby Walmart or Publix on US-192 to stock up on snacks and drinks for your final park day.

meals.breakfast: Cook simple items in the hotel room if you have a microwave/mini-fridge, or enjoy continental breakfast if offered. Alternatively, grab breakfast from a nearby IHOP or Denny's on US-192 (~$8-12/person).
meals.lunch: Earl of Sandwich at Disney Springs — one of the best value meals near Disney World. Hot sandwiches, salads, and soups at very reasonable prices (~$8-12/person). A fan-favorite budget option.
meals.dinner: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — build-your-own artisan pizzas at an affordable price (~$10-13/person). Or try The Polite Pig for BBQ with a slightly higher but still reasonable price point (~$14-18/person).

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and park (self-parking is free in the garages). This is a great day to purchase any Disney souvenirs — prices are the same as in the parks but the atmosphere is more relaxed and you can shop without rushing between rides. The hotel's free shuttle may not go directly to Disney Springs — confirm with the front desk or budget for a rideshare.

day_by_day.morning: Take the hotel shuttle back to Magic Kingdom for a final morning — use this day to revisit your favorite rides, catch anything you missed on Day 2, or simply soak in the atmosphere of Main Street U.S.A. Grab a Mickey-shaped waffle or a Dole Whip (a Disney classic, ~$6) as a farewell treat. Ride any must-do attractions with shorter morning wait times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart the park by early afternoon. Return to the hotel, check out (or store luggage with the front desk if your flight is later), and freshen up. Do a final sweep of the room for any forgotten items. If time allows, take one last dip in the hotel pool. Arrange your airport transportation — book a rideshare in advance or confirm shuttle options with the hotel.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport with plenty of time before your departure flight. Enjoy a final Florida meal at the airport or a nearby restaurant on the way. Reflect on an incredible week at the most magical place on Earth!

meals.breakfast: Casey's Corner on Main Street U.S.A. in Magic Kingdom — hot dogs and breakfast items at reasonable prices (~$8-12). Or bring snacks from the hotel for a quick park breakfast.
meals.lunch: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn and Cafe in Frontierland — burgers, wraps, and a well-stocked toppings bar to customize your meal (~$12-15/person). A great final park lunch.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or a final meal at a restaurant near the hotel on US-192 — Perkins Restaurant & Bakery or Bob Evans offer hearty, affordable American meals (~$10-15/person) before heading to the airport.

day_by_day.notes: On your final Magic Kingdom morning, arrive early to maximize your last few hours. The park is often less crowded on Sunday mornings. Don't forget to take photos on Main Street U.S.A. with Cinderella Castle as a backdrop — a perfect trip memento. Budget tip: any unused snack credits or leftover park snacks can be enjoyed at the airport. Allow at least 2.5-3 hours before your flight for airport check-in and security at MCO, which can be very busy in summer.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Take Mears Connect shuttle or rideshare (~25 min) to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and get settled. Pick up any essentials at the nearby Walmart Supercenter on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (open 24 hrs, ~5 min drive).

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night bite at Denny's or IHOP near the hotel (both open 24 hrs within 1 mile) – budget ~$15–20/person

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light – rest is essential before the parks. Confirm hotel shuttle schedule for the next day. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done and link your park tickets. Lay out comfortable walking shoes and sunscreen for tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM) via the free hotel theme park shuttle. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin before crowds build. Then hit the Haunted Mansion and Pirates of the Caribbean in Liberty Square and Adventureland.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration. Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane if available). Enjoy the afternoon parade down Main Street U.S.A. (~3:00 PM). Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed (shuttle runs regularly) to rest and freshen up.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening. Experience 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (~9:00 PM). Stroll Main Street U.S.A. for souvenir shopping before park close. Take the hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Grab-and-go breakfast at hotel or quick stop at Main Street Bakery inside Magic Kingdom (Mickey waffles, coffee) – ~$12–15/person
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches in a themed setting – ~$15–18/person
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Café in Frontierland – Tex-Mex bowls, nachos, and burgers with a generous toppings bar – ~$15–20/person

day_by_day.notes: Wear light, breathable clothing – June in Orlando is hot and humid (avg. 91°F/33°C). Stay hydrated with free water cups available at any quick-service location. Purchase a refillable resort mug if staying multiple days. Book Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance via the app.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Arrive at EPCOT opening (~9:00 AM) via hotel shuttle. Start in Future World (now World Discovery & World Nature) – ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Head to World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the 11 country pavilions around World Showcase Lagoon. Sample authentic cuisines and snacks from Mexico (churros, margaritas), Japan (sushi, mochi), France (crêpes), and Morocco (hummus, flatbread). Browse artisan shops and cultural exhibits. Catch a live cultural performance or film in one of the pavilions.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon (~9:00 PM) – one of the most impressive shows at Disney World. Grab a final dessert from the France or Italy pavilion before heading back via hotel shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel continental breakfast or quick stop at Sunshine Seasons in EPCOT's Land Pavilion – fresh options, smoothies – ~$12–15/person
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase – budget ~$20–25/person on 3–4 small plates/snacks across different country pavilions (a fun foodie experience)
meals.dinner: Coral Reef Restaurant (EPCOT) – mid-range sit-down dining with an aquarium view, seafood and pasta dishes – ~$30–40/person; reserve via OpenTable or My Disney Experience app

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is very walkable but large – comfortable shoes are a must. The World Showcase loop is ~1.2 miles. Consider renting a stroller if traveling with young children. International Food & Wine Festival may be running in June – check Disney's calendar for bonus food booths.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Arrive at rope drop (~9:00 AM) via hotel shuttle. Head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book a time slot for Savi's Workshop (Build a Custom Lightsaber – ~$249.99, reserve in advance) or Droid Depot (Build a Droid – ~$119.99). Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first thing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides – use Individual Lightning Lane). Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios: Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Alien Swirling Saucers), and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show at the Hollywood Hills Amphitheater (~8:30 PM or 10:00 PM – check schedule). This classic water, fire, and projection show is a Hollywood Studios highlight. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge – Ronto Wraps and Meiloorun Fruit Juice for an immersive Star Wars breakfast – ~$14–18/person
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – themed quick-service with bowls, ribs, and plant-based options – ~$16–20/person
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café in Hollywood Studios – comfort food (meatloaf, pot roast, milkshakes) in a retro TV-themed diner – ~$25–35/person; reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot require advance reservations and sell out quickly – book as early as possible (60 days out). Rise of the Resistance Individual Lightning Lane should be purchased at 7:00 AM on the day of your visit. Bring extra budget for Galaxy's Edge merchandise and experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage. Arrive at rope drop (~8:00 AM) via hotel shuttle – Animal Kingdom opens early. Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride – lines grow fast). Also ride Na'vi River Journey for a gentler experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a Kilimanjaro Safari tour (~20-min open-air vehicle ride) to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, and hippos in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Catch the 'Festival of the Lion King' live show – a spectacular Broadway-style performance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the 'Rivers of Light' or 'Tree of Life Awakening' evening experience as the park winds down. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks (~8:00–9:00 PM). Return to hotel for a relaxed evening – use the pool at the Ramada or explore the nearby International Drive area for entertainment.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at Harambe Market near the Africa section – African-spiced eggs, sausage, and juice – ~$12–15/person
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – one of Disney's best quick-service spots with healthy grain bowls, protein options, and blueberry cream cheese mousse – ~$16–20/person
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia section of Animal Kingdom – pan-Asian cuisine (fried rice, noodles, duck) in a beautifully themed space – ~$25–35/person; reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the safari. Bring bug spray for the outdoor trails. The park is very shaded compared to others, which is a relief in June heat. Check the app for live entertainment schedules as they vary by season.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – No park ticket needed! Take the hotel shuttle or a short rideshare to Disney Springs. Start with a leisurely morning stroll through the Town Center and Marketplace areas. Visit the LEGO Store (massive outdoor LEGO sculptures), World of Disney (largest Disney merchandise store), and browse unique shops.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy free street entertainment, live music, and performers throughout Disney Springs. Visit Splitsville Luxury Lanes for bowling and entertainment (~$18–25/person, great for families). Explore the Art of Disney gallery and check out the NBA Experience or Cirque du Soleil 'Drawn to Life' show (tickets ~$75–114/person – optional splurge).
day_by_day.evening: Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy live music at one of the waterfront venues. This is also a great evening for souvenir shopping at competitive prices. Return to hotel at a relaxed pace – use this as a recovery day before the final park day.

meals.breakfast: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs – wood-smoked BBQ breakfast bowls and craft coffee in a casual setting – ~$14–18/person
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or Chicken Guy! (Guy Fieri's restaurant) at Disney Springs – casual, quick, and budget-friendly – ~$12–16/person
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – waterfront dining with steaks, seafood, and Amphicar tours on the water; mid-range splurge night – ~$35–50/person; reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park (self-parking is free for the first 3 hours with validation). This is a great budget-recovery day after heavy park spending. Saturday can be crowded – arrive early for the best experience. Check the Disney Springs entertainment calendar for special performances.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite park or explore a missed highlight. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any missed rides (Peter Pan's Flight, Jungle Cruise, Tron Lightcycle Run if available) or revisit EPCOT for Future World attractions. Alternatively, visit a Disney water park – Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach (separate ticket ~$79/person) for a refreshing finale.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final afternoon at the parks or relax at the Ramada hotel pool. Do any last-minute souvenir shopping at Disney Springs or hotel gift shop. Pack bags and prepare for departure. Check out any late checkout options with the hotel (typically until 12:00 PM; request late checkout if needed).
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport. Allow 2–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security. Take a rideshare, Mears Connect, or hotel shuttle to the airport. Reflect on an amazing Disney World adventure!

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or grab pastries and coffee at a nearby Starbucks or Dunkin' on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy – ~$8–12/person
meals.lunch: Final Disney park meal – Casey's Corner at Magic Kingdom (hot dogs, corn dog nuggets) or a World Showcase snack at EPCOT – ~$12–16/person
meals.dinner: Airport dining at MCO or a farewell meal at TGI Fridays / Chili's near the hotel before heading to the airport – ~$18–25/person

day_by_day.notes: Check your flight time carefully and plan airport departure accordingly (MCO is ~25–30 min from the hotel without traffic, but allow extra time on Sundays). Return any rental equipment, confirm shuttle times with the hotel front desk the night before. Save digital copies of all park tickets and receipts. Consider joining Disney's email list for future trip discounts.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

experiences.description: Immerse your family in the Star Wars universe at Batuu. Build a custom lightsaber at Savi's Workshop, pilot the Millennium Falcon on Smugglers Run, and experience the thrilling Rise of the Resistance ride. Dine at the Oga's Cantina for themed drinks and snacks.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Galaxy's Edge, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day
experiences.description: Spend a budget-friendly day at Disney Springs exploring free entertainment, street performers, and unique dining. Visit the LEGO Store, enjoy a meal at T-REX Cafe, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24, and browse over 100 shops and restaurants with no park admission required.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

experiences.name: Animal Kingdom Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage
experiences.description: Start your morning with a Kilimanjaro Safari to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, and rhinos in a realistic savanna setting. Then soar over Pandora on the breathtaking Avatar Flight of Passage ride. Explore the Pandora World of Avatar at dusk when the bioluminescent landscape glows beautifully.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Pandora & Africa Sections, Lake Buena Vista, Orlando

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight UA arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit. Flight arrives late evening.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30. Use Ramada's complimentary theme park shuttle or arrange a private car transfer to the hotel. Check in to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Unwind with a late-night snack from the hotel's amenities or a nearby 24-hour convenience stop.

meals.breakfast: On the flight or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the flight or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night arrival – grab a light bite at the hotel or a nearby late-night spot such as Denny's (open 24 hrs, 2 min drive) or order room service if available

day_by_day.notes: Pack light carry-on essentials for easy late-night check-in. Confirm shuttle schedule with the hotel in advance or pre-book a private luxury car service (e.g., Mears Connect First Class or a private limo) for a seamless arrival. Get to bed early – big park days start tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day – Arrive at rope drop (park opens ~9:00 AM). Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs ~8:00 AM). Start with Tomorrowland: Space Mountain and Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin. Move to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train (use Lightning Lane Multi Pass for priority access). Visit Cinderella Castle for photos and explore Liberty Square's Haunted Mansion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration – After lunch, head to Adventureland for Pirates of the Caribbean and Jungle Cruise. Explore Frontierland's Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Use Lightning Lane Single Pass for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train if not done in the morning. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel (shuttle back) or relax in the park's shaded areas.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime shows. Watch the 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle (typically ~9:00 PM). Enjoy the Main Street Electrical Parade if running. Ride favorites again with shorter evening wait times before park close.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before shuttle departure – or grab a quick bite at Main Street Bakery (Starbucks partner) inside Magic Kingdom upon arrival
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom) – Premium prix-fixe lunch in the enchanted Beast's Castle; reserve via Disney dining reservations well in advance
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table – Iconic fine-dining inside Cinderella Castle with character meet-and-greets; prix-fixe menu featuring premium American cuisine; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass and individual Lightning Lane selections through the My Disney Experience app first thing in the morning. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a portable fan, and a refillable water bottle. The free hotel shuttle typically runs on a schedule – confirm times the night before.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT (opens ~9:00 AM). Begin in Future World/World Discovery: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane) and Test Track. Head to World Nature for Soarin' Around the World with stunning aerial cinematography. Arrive at World Showcase as it opens (~11:00 AM) and begin exploring pavilions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the EPCOT World Showcase experience – Stroll through Mexico (ride Gran Fiesta Tour), Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France (Remy's Ratatouille Adventure), United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample authentic cuisines and artisan goods at each pavilion. Participate in any cultural demonstrations or live entertainment on the World Showcase stage.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Harmonious' nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon – one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Enjoy a leisurely dinner at a World Showcase restaurant before the show. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: The Wave… of American Flavors at Disney's Contemporary Resort (short drive/monorail) – farm-to-table breakfast with organic options; or hotel breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Chefs de France (France Pavilion, EPCOT) – Authentic French brasserie cuisine with crepes, croque monsieurs, and classic French entrées in an elegant setting
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion, EPCOT) – Premium teppanyaki dining experience with skilled chefs preparing Wagyu beef, lobster, and seasonal Japanese dishes tableside

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive – wear comfortable walking shoes. The World Showcase is best explored at a leisurely pace; don't rush. Book all dining reservations 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience. Consider the EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival if visiting during that season (typically July–November) for additional culinary experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios – Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios (opens ~9:00 AM). Head straight to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge at Batuu. Book Savi's Workshop (Build Your Own Lightsaber) – a premium, immersive 20-minute experience ($250+ per lightsaber; book well in advance). Explore the Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run attraction. Visit Oga's Cantina for exotic themed beverages (reservations required).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Hollywood Studios – Experience Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most technologically advanced rides; use Lightning Lane). Visit Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Explore the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular if scheduled.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the 'Fantasmic!' nighttime spectacular at Hollywood Studios – a dramatic water, fire, and projection show featuring Mickey Mouse. Alternatively, catch the 'Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular' fireworks show. Dine at a premium Hollywood Studios restaurant before the evening show. Return to hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or grab a quick bite at Trolley Car Café (Starbucks) inside Hollywood Studios at park opening
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant (Hollywood Studios) – Unique drive-in movie theater themed restaurant serving premium burgers, steaks, and milkshakes while watching classic sci-fi film clips
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby (Hollywood Studios) – Iconic fine-dining replica of the legendary Hollywood restaurant; signature Cobb Salad, premium steaks, and fresh seafood in an elegant Art Deco setting

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations are extremely limited and sell out fast – book exactly 60 days in advance at 7:00 AM EST via My Disney Experience or call Disney directly. The Droid Depot (Build Your Own Droid, ~$120) is a great alternative or addition for kids. Oga's Cantina has a 45-minute seating limit and requires reservations.

day_by_day.morning: Animal Kingdom – Kilimanjaro Safari & Avatar Flight of Passage – Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom (opens ~8:00 AM; early entry available for some guests). Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Avatar: Flight of Passage (Lightning Lane Single Pass highly recommended – this is the most in-demand ride at Walt Disney World). Explore the bioluminescent Na'vi River Journey boat ride. Walk through the stunning Pandora landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Animal Kingdom – Head to Africa for the Kilimanjaro Safari (morning or early afternoon for best wildlife activity). Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, rhinos, hippos, and more in a realistic savanna setting. Explore the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail. Visit Asia for Expedition Everest roller coaster and Kali River Rapids (bring a change of clothes or ponchos). Explore DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Animal Kingdom's 'Rivers of Light' nighttime spectacular (check current schedule as programming may vary). Alternatively, enjoy the Tree of Life Awakenings projection show at dusk – a magical free experience. Dine at a premium Animal Kingdom restaurant before heading back to the hotel for a restful evening.

meals.breakfast: Tusker House Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Donald's Safari Breakfast character dining with African-inspired breakfast buffet; meet Donald Duck, Daisy, Mickey, and Goofy in safari attire
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora, Animal Kingdom) – Healthy, flavorful bowls with premium proteins (slow-roasted Rongi beans, wood-grilled chicken, sustainable fish) in a stunning Pandora setting
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – Disney's most upscale Animal Kingdom dining; globally inspired fine cuisine celebrating the art of travel; signature dishes include whole-roasted chicken, sustainable fish, and premium desserts; extensive wine and cocktail list

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active on the Kilimanjaro Safari. Bring insect repellent and sunscreen. Avatar: Flight of Passage is a simulator ride – not suitable for guests with severe motion sickness. The park typically closes earlier than other Disney parks, so plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Take the hotel's free shuttle to Disney Springs (no park ticket required). Explore the vibrant waterfront shopping, dining, and entertainment complex. Visit the LEGO Store for an interactive family experience. Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world). Check out the Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney-themed boutiques. Enjoy live street performers and musicians throughout the complex.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Disney Springs – Visit the NBA Experience (interactive basketball activities) or Splitsville Luxury Lanes (upscale bowling and entertainment). Explore the Town Center and The Landing districts. Shop at premium retailers including Kate Spade, Tommy Bahama, and Anthropologie. Visit the Disney PhotoPass Studio for professional family portraits. Enjoy the free outdoor entertainment and waterfront ambiance.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a premium dinner at one of Disney Springs' signature restaurants. After dinner, catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 (IMAX available) or enjoy live music at one of the entertainment venues. Stroll the illuminated waterfront promenade before returning to the hotel via shuttle for a relaxed evening.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast – take advantage of a leisurely morning start; or visit The Polite Pig (Disney Springs) for a Southern-inspired brunch with craft cocktails
meals.lunch: Wine Bar George (Disney Springs) – Master Sommelier George Miliotes' flagship restaurant; premium charcuterie boards, flatbreads, and small plates paired with an exceptional wine selection
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) – Celebrity Chef Masaharu Morimoto's pan-Asian masterpiece; signature dishes include Peking duck, sushi platters, and Wagyu beef; stunning two-story restaurant with dramatic décor; extensive sake and cocktail menu

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and park (self-parking is complimentary for the first 3 hours with validation). This is a great recovery day after intense park days. The Springs is typically less crowded on weekday mornings. Many shops and restaurants open at 10:00 AM. Live entertainment is scattered throughout the day – check the Disney Springs entertainment schedule online.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a favorite park or explore a new experience – Based on the week's highlights, choose a return visit to the most-loved park using any remaining Lightning Lane credits. Alternatively, visit Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park for a refreshing finale (separate ticket required; premium cabana rentals available). Enjoy a leisurely morning with a premium resort breakfast before heading out.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Disney World experiences – If returning to a park, focus on any missed attractions or re-riding favorites. Consider a VIP Tour Guide experience through Disney (private guided park tour, $450–$900/hour, minimum 7 hours) for the ultimate luxury send-off. Visit the resort's pool or spa for relaxation. Begin packing and preparing for departure. Check out of the hotel (standard checkout ~11:00 AM; request late checkout if needed).
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at a world-class Orlando restaurant outside Disney property for a change of scenery. Head to Orlando International Airport for departure or extend your stay. Reflect on an unforgettable week of Disney magic with the family.

meals.breakfast: Grand Floridian Café (Disney's Grand Floridian Resort) – Elegant Victorian-style breakfast with eggs Benedict, French toast, and fresh pastries; accessible via Disney monorail from the Transportation & Ticket Center
meals.lunch: Paddlefish (Disney Springs) – Upscale seafood restaurant aboard a stunning multi-deck riverboat; fresh oysters, lobster bisque, and premium seafood entrées with beautiful waterfront views
meals.dinner: The Ravenous Pig (Winter Park, Orlando) – Award-winning James Beard-nominated gastropub; farm-to-table American cuisine with craft cocktails; a beloved local institution for a memorable farewell meal (approx. 25-min drive from hotel)

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout from Ramada to maximize your final day without rushing. Store luggage at the front desk if needed. Confirm return transportation to Orlando International Airport – pre-book a private luxury car or Mears Connect First Class for a stress-free departure. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for airport security and check-in. Don't forget to download all Disney PhotoPass photos before your Memory Maker subscription expires!

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
